_note: Naming. giver = the NPC id whose conversation is followed by the naming offer (dialogue: that conversation; its speaker lines must use the same id). player_speaker = the speakers.json id of the player. cats = every cat the Name Editor can rename, in its order (the player first): prefix + suffix ids from prefixes.json / suffixes.json, or a fixed starting name until renamed, and a rank. In text, {player_name} is the player's name and {name_<cat id>} any cat's. ranks = every rank in the editor's order, each with its label and its symbol (an art key; none = no symbol). endings = a placeholder per rank for later rank-based names (not used yet).
